name: Ozark Highlands

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Grenache, Carignan, Zinfandel and Nebbiolo fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. It is very acid, which locks up nutrients, so growers spread lime to raise the pH.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Big crops are possible, but quality tops out at acceptable.
